SOUTHERN WATCH - what this campaign needs

Derived from the units its missions place, the squadrons and hull
variants they name, the rounds their loadouts hang and the units its
roster sells. The pack-level REQUIRED-MODS.txt two folders up, at the
pack's root, is the union across every campaign in the pack.

1. HARD REQUIRED (79): a mission names a file of theirs, or a mod above says it cannot run without them.

1b. ONLY FOR THE DISPATCHES (63): the optional browser missions in missions/Southern Watch - Dispatches place these; the campaign
itself never loads them. Keep them installed anyway: SETUP checks every
mod in LOAD-ORDER.txt and stops if one is missing.
